recipes.name: Greek Island Chicken Shish Kebabs
ingredients_raw: 2 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breast, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces
2 large green or red bell peppers, cut into 1-inch pieces
1 large onion, quartered and separated into pieces

steps.text: Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, vinegar, garlic, cumin, oregano, thyme, salt, and black pepper together in a large glass or ceramic bowl. Add chicken and toss to evenly coat. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap; marinate in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours.
Meanwhile, soak wooden skewers in water for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat an outdoor grill for medium-high heat and lightly oil the grate.
Remove chicken from marinade and shake off excess. Discard remaining marinade. Thread chicken onto the skewers, alternating with bell peppers, onion, mushrooms, and tomatoes.

Cook skewers on preheated grill, turning frequently, until nicely browned on all sides, and meat is no longer pink in the center, about 10 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).

raw_recipe.headline: Greek Island Chicken Shish Kebabs
raw_recipe.description: This Greek Island chicken shish kebab recipe features chicken marinated in a Greek-style mixture of herbs and oil before added to skewers with veggies.

review.reviewBody: I just wrote thyme in my original post, not dried, I always use fresh.... If you are using dried make sure it is good quality thyme or you will end up with it leaving a bitter taste in your mouth! If you don't like thyme just leave it out or try marjoram or savory instead....the cumin in it gives it that something extra.... I originally got this recipe from a friend who lives in the Greek Islands...For some reason the recipe only says 1/4 cup olive oil, I use 1/2 a cup or even amounts of oil to lemon and vinegar (my friend just uses lemon juice in the original recipe no vinegar, she uses 2 cups of olive oil to 1 cup of fresh lemon juice)

Delicious! I made just a few changes. I substituted zucchini for the tomatoes. I left out the vinegar.(I followed the recipe that was in the Aug/September 2020 Allrecipes magazine which is slightly different on the spices than what is shown here. )I did not use skewers. Instead, I lined a baking sheet with foil and tossed everything on there together. We will definitely be making this again.

Delicious!! Allergic to tomatoes so I did not use those. I cooked it all together stir-fry style in a skillet because my grill is 'out of order'. Had Tzatziki sauce on the side for dipping. It turned out great, will definitely make again. Thanks!

I substituted the chicken for beef and cooked it on the grill for only a few minutes. I made some cucumber sauce and with the pita cooked with olive oil on my griddle for a few minutes, it was as good as any open gyro I've had in any resturant! freezes well!

Awesome! My new favorite Greek recipe for summer. I used mushroom, zucchini, onion and red pepper. The tomatoes I stuffed with a blend of feta, roasted garlic and basil, and served as an appatizer. I also de-kabobed them and sprinkled with feta, everything better with cheese! the flavors of the marinade are so amazing they should be brushed on everything.
I liked it very much, but it was dry. So I served it on brown rice then I made the marinade for the chicken and poured it over the vegetables, meat and rice before serving. DELICIOUS!

I followed the marinade recipe closely using dried spices. In had one pound of chicken breasts. So, there was plenty of marinade. I only marinated the chicken for about 30 minutes. I did put the chicken on skewers on the grill along with mushrooms, green pepper and zucchini. The chicken and vegetables cooked quickly on a hot charcoal grill. I kept an eye on it so that nothing burned. I think this is delicious and I will definitely make this again. It's a light, healthy meal and easy enough to put together. I really enjoyed this figure-fnriendly meal.

I make mine with lamb chunks (have your butcher turn a leg of lamb into skewer size chunks - no charge where I shop), and I add eggplant chunks to this… Eggplant is the main ingredient in a number of Greek dishes, so the addition is a natural!
I've done this both as kebabs and sheet pan. Absolutely yummy. Everyone devoured! I added some fingerling potatoes and used red onion. Served with pita and Tzatziki
We used air fryer and probably needs about 5-7 mins less cooking time than we did, chicken got a bit dry
Did it without the skewers and served with rice. There were no leftovers from the 40 people I served it to!
This was really good and simple . Will make again .
You can not beat a good sishkabab with a good Greek salad and garlic sauce with Lebanese bread.yum 😋
I just made the chicken. Mostly made as directed, but a bit less vinegar in favour of lemon. Marinated four hours.Turned out nice and tender on the grill.
Love the flavor, this has become a go to for our family.
I made the recipe as written. Very good. I think I might eliminate the vinegar, increase the lemon juice ad increase the oil oil next time.
A family member made it! Have been looking fo a marinade I love. Found it!

I really liked this recipe. Very bright and flavorful. Great on the grill. I served with a side of jasmine rice. Chicken was very tender. My family thought it was a little too lemony/vinegary, so I may reduce the acids for next time or try balance it with something sweet.
This is a super delicious recipe! I have tried many other Greek marinade recipes and this is by far the best!
Excellent recipe. I marinated the chicken overnight and it was exceptionally tender. Other than that, I adhered to the recipe and loved it. Will definitely make it again!
